description: This source file contains a benchmark class for testing and measuring the performance of Orleans serialization for complex object graphs, including circular references. It includes setup of serializers, sample data initialization, and various benchmark/test methods for serialization, deserialization, copying, and message serialization related to Orleans framework objects.

classes.name: ComplexTypeBenchmarks
classes.description: A set of performance benchmarks for Orleans serialization of complex object types, including setup, serialization, deserialization, copying, and message serialization.

methods.name: SerializeComplex
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a complex object to benchmark performance.

methods.name: CopyComplex
methods.description: Copies a complex class object using the deep copier.

methods.name: CopyComplexStruct
methods.description: Copies a simple struct object using the deep copier.

methods.name: OrleansStructRoundTrip
methods.description: Performs a round-trip serialization/deserialization of a simple struct to measure throughput.

methods.name: OrleansClassRoundTrip
methods.description: Performs a round-trip serialization/deserialization of a complex class object (commented out in the code).

methods.name: OrleansSerialize
methods.description: Serializes a complex object into the Orleans format (benchmark placeholder).

methods.name: OrleansDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a complex object from Orleans format (benchmark placeholder).

methods.name: OrleansReadEachByte
methods.description: Reads through all bytes of the serialized payload one by one, XOR-ing their values, for performance measurement.
